set -eu; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a9e89bef5cf6cb3ec7300eeedb27803397ac1f78"; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed -n '1p'); adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/t0-start.xml >/dev/null; if ! adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/t0-start.xml | grep -q 'Telemetry & AI Bridge'; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 75 160; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/t0-drawer.xml >/dev/null; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/t0-drawer.xml | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); n=next(x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("text")=="Telemetry & AI Bridge"); print(n.attrib["bounds"])'); XY=$(printf '%s' "$B" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 1; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/t0-telemetry.xml >/dev/null; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/t0-telemetry.xml | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); n=next(x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("text") in ("Connect Google account","Change Google account")); print(n.attrib["bounds"])'); XY=$(printf '%s' "$B" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/t0-chooser.xml >/dev/null; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/t0-chooser.xml | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); n=next((x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("resource-id")=="com.google.android.gms:id/account_name" and x.attrib.get("text")=="meehow939@gmail.com"),None); assert n is not None, "meehow939@gmail.com not found in chooser"; print(n.attrib["bounds"])'); XY=$(printf '%s' "$B" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 2; echo '--- resumed ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | head -5 || true; echo '--- post-selection UI ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/t0-post.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/t0-post.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/></>
</g' | grep -E 'Choose an account|requesting access|Allow|Continue|Cancel|Drive|Gmail|Authorization failed|Google authorization|Account|scope|BlueEye|Telemetry|error|Error|meehow939' | head -220 || true; echo '--- logcat ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -Ei 'io\.blueeye|AuthorizationClient|AuthorizationActivity|GoogleAuth|ApiException|DEVELOPER_ERROR|UNREGISTERED|SIGN_IN|oauth' | tail -220 || true
